trials.name: Per-channel axial mixing
trials.hypothesis: The target channels are shifted cyclically by X/2, so a local CNN can't line them up with the build. This candidate adds a learned linear map per channel along x and along y, on the input and again on mid-level features, so the network can learn the realignment itself. Expect positive dev success and episodes that place bricks. If it still collapses to DONE before any placement (0.000), then misalignment is not the main obstacle.

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
import math

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class AxialMix(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, ny, nx):
        super().__init__()
        self.wx = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(c, nx, nx))
        self.wy = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(c, ny, ny))
        self.bx = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(c, 1, nx))
        self.by = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(c, ny, 1))
        nn.init.uniform_(self.wx, -1.0 / math.sqrt(nx), 1.0 / math.sqrt(nx))
        nn.init.uniform_(self.wy, -1.0 / math.sqrt(ny), 1.0 / math.sqrt(ny))

    def forward(self, f):
        mx = torch.einsum('bcyx,cxw->bcyw', f, self.wx) + self.bx
        my = torch.einsum('bcyx,cyv->bcvx', f, self.wy) + self.by
        return mx, my


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        C = spec.in_channels
        self.inmix = AxialMix(C, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(3 * C, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.mix2 = AxialMix(WIDTH, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.fuse = nn.Conv2d(3 * WIDTH, WIDTH, 1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        mx, my = self.inmix(obs)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, mx, my], dim=1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        ax, ay = self.mix2(x)
        x = F.relu(x + self.fuse(torch.cat([x, ax, ay], dim=1)))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

trials.name: Cell transformer + sinusoid coords
trials.hypothesis: Treat each cell as a token, with sinusoidal x/y coordinate channels and learned positional embeddings, and use two pre-LayerNorm self-attention layers. Then a 3x3 conv and the footprint pool head. With these encodings, attention can learn to fetch target information from X/2 columns away, which fixes the shift. If this scores 0 while axial mixing succeeds, attention is too slow to learn the offset within the budget. If both score 0, the obstacle is elsewhere (the DONE collapse or credit assignment).

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
import math

D = 48
HEADS = 4
FF = 96
NLAYERS = 2
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
NFREQ = 2


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, heads, ff):
        super().__init__()
        self.h = heads
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.o = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.ln2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, ff), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(ff, d))

    def forward(self, t):
        B, N, Dm = t.shape
        hd = Dm // self.h
        q, k, v = self.qkv(self.ln1(t)).chunk(3, dim=-1)
        q = q.reshape(B, N, self.h, hd).transpose(1, 2)
        k = k.reshape(B, N, self.h, hd).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.reshape(B, N, self.h, hd).transpose(1, 2)
        a = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-2, -1)) / math.sqrt(hd), dim=-1)
        y = torch.matmul(a, v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, Dm)
        t = t + self.o(y)
        t = t + self.ff(self.ln2(t))
        return t


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


def coord_channels(Y, X):
    ys = torch.arange(Y, dtype=torch.float32).view(Y, 1).expand(Y, X)
    xs = torch.arange(X, dtype=torch.float32).view(1, X).expand(Y, X)
    chans = []
    for k in range(1, NFREQ + 1):
        ax = 2.0 * math.pi * k * xs / X
        ay = 2.0 * math.pi * k * ys / Y
        chans += [torch.sin(ax), torch.cos(ax), torch.sin(ay), torch.cos(ay)]
    return torch.stack(chans, 0).unsqueeze(0)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = spec.Y
        self.X = spec.X
        self.register_buffer('coords', coord_channels(spec.Y, spec.X))
        ncoord = 4 * NFREQ
        self.stem = nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + ncoord, D, 1)
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, spec.Y * spec.X, D) * 0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block(D, HEADS, FF) for _ in range(NLAYERS)])
        self.lnf = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(D, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        c = self.coords.expand(B, -1, -1, -1)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, c], dim=1))
        t = s.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2) + self.pos
        for blk in self.blocks:
            t = blk(t)
        t = self.lnf(t)
        f = t.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, D, self.Y, self.X)
        f = F.relu(self.conv(f))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
import math

RECIPE = {'n_envs': 128, 'rollout_len': 16, 'n_minibatches': 16, 'ppo_epochs': 3, 'ent_coef': 0.02, 'lr': 0.001}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class AxialMix(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, ny, nx):
        super().__init__()
        self.wx = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(c, nx, nx))
        self.wy = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(c, ny, ny))
        self.bx = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(c, 1, nx))
        self.by = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(c, ny, 1))
        nn.init.uniform_(self.wx, -1.0 / math.sqrt(nx), 1.0 / math.sqrt(nx))
        nn.init.uniform_(self.wy, -1.0 / math.sqrt(ny), 1.0 / math.sqrt(ny))

    def forward(self, f):
        mx = torch.einsum('bcyx,cxw->bcyw', f, self.wx) + self.bx
        my = torch.einsum('bcyx,cyv->bcvx', f, self.wy) + self.by
        return mx, my


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        C = spec.in_channels
        self.inmix = AxialMix(C, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(3 * C, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.mix2 = AxialMix(WIDTH, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.fuse = nn.Conv2d(3 * WIDTH, WIDTH, 1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        mx, my = self.inmix(obs)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, mx, my], dim=1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        ax, ay = self.mix2(x)
        x = F.relu(x + self.fuse(torch.cat([x, ax, ay], dim=1)))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch.nn.functional as F
import math

COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32

def xroll(t, s):
    return torch.cat([t[..., s:], t[..., :s]], dim=-1)


class AxialMix(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, ny, nx):
        super().__init__()
        self.wx = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(c, nx, nx))
        self.wy = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(c, ny, ny))
        self.bx = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(c, 1, nx))
        self.by = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(c, ny, 1))
        nn.init.uniform_(self.wx, -1.0 / math.sqrt(nx), 1.0 / math.sqrt(nx))
        nn.init.uniform_(self.wy, -1.0 / math.sqrt(ny), 1.0 / math.sqrt(ny))

    def forward(self, f):
        mx = torch.einsum('bcyx,cxw->bcyw', f, self.wx) + self.bx
        my = torch.einsum('bcyx,cyv->bcvx', f, self.wy) + self.by
        return mx, my

        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        C = spec.in_channels
        self.Z = spec.Z
        self.sh = spec.X // 2
        nroll = 3 * spec.Z + 1
        self.inmix = AxialMix(C, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(3 * C + nroll, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)

        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)

    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
import math

RECIPE = {'lr': 0.0005, 'ent_coef': 0.02}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


def xroll(t, s):
    return torch.cat([t[..., s:], t[..., :s]], dim=-1)


class AxialMix(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, ny, nx):
        super().__init__()
        self.wx = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(c, nx, nx))
        self.wy = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(c, ny, ny))
        self.bx = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(c, 1, nx))
        self.by = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(c, ny, 1))
        nn.init.uniform_(self.wx, -1.0 / math.sqrt(nx), 1.0 / math.sqrt(nx))
        nn.init.uniform_(self.wy, -1.0 / math.sqrt(ny), 1.0 / math.sqrt(ny))

    def forward(self, f):
        mx = torch.einsum('bcyx,cxw->bcyw', f, self.wx) + self.bx
        my = torch.einsum('bcyx,cyv->bcvx', f, self.wy) + self.by
        return mx, my


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        C = spec.in_channels
        self.Z = spec.Z
        self.sh = spec.X // 2
        nroll = 3 * spec.Z + 1
        self.inmix = AxialMix(C, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(3 * C + nroll, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.mix2 = AxialMix(WIDTH, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.fuse = nn.Conv2d(3 * WIDTH, WIDTH, 1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        Z = self.Z
        tsel = torch.cat([obs[:, Z:4 * Z], obs[:, 4 * Z + 1:4 * Z + 2]], dim=1)
        rolled = xroll(tsel, self.sh)
        mx, my = self.inmix(obs)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, rolled, mx, my], dim=1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        ax, ay = self.mix2(x)
        x = F.relu(x + self.fuse(torch.cat([x, ax, ay], dim=1)))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

            nn.init.zeros_(o.bias)

        self.nt = spec.n_types
        self.np = spec.n_place
        self.sh = spec.X // 2
        nroll = 3 * spec.Z + 1
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(C + nroll + spec.n_types, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
import math

RECIPE = {'ppo_epochs': 2}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


def xroll(t, s):
    return torch.cat([t[..., s:], t[..., :s]], dim=-1)


class AxialMix(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, ny, nx):
        super().__init__()
        self.wx = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(c, nx, nx))
        self.wy = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(c, ny, ny))
        self.bx = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(c, 1, nx))
        self.by = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(c, ny, 1))
        nn.init.uniform_(self.wx, -1.0 / math.sqrt(nx), 1.0 / math.sqrt(nx))
        nn.init.uniform_(self.wy, -1.0 / math.sqrt(ny), 1.0 / math.sqrt(ny))

    def forward(self, f):
        mx = torch.einsum('bcyx,cxw->bcyw', f, self.wx) + self.bx
        my = torch.einsum('bcyx,cyv->bcvx', f, self.wy) + self.by
        return mx, my


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        C = spec.in_channels
        self.Z = spec.Z
        self.sh = spec.X // 2
        nroll = 3 * spec.Z + 1
        self.inmix = AxialMix(C, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(3 * C + nroll, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.mix2 = AxialMix(WIDTH, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.fuse = nn.Conv2d(3 * WIDTH, WIDTH, 1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        Z = self.Z
        tsel = torch.cat([obs[:, Z:4 * Z], obs[:, 4 * Z + 1:4 * Z + 2]], dim=1)
        rolled = xroll(tsel, self.sh)
        mx, my = self.inmix(obs)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, rolled, mx, my], dim=1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        ax, ay = self.mix2(x)
        x = F.relu(x + self.fuse(torch.cat([x, ax, ay], dim=1)))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
import math

RECIPE = {'ppo_epochs': 1, 'n_minibatches': 64}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


def xroll(t, s):
    return torch.cat([t[..., s:], t[..., :s]], dim=-1)


class AxialMix(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, ny, nx):
        super().__init__()
        self.wx = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(c, nx, nx))
        self.wy = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(c, ny, ny))
        self.bx = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(c, 1, nx))
        self.by = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(c, ny, 1))
        nn.init.uniform_(self.wx, -1.0 / math.sqrt(nx), 1.0 / math.sqrt(nx))
        nn.init.uniform_(self.wy, -1.0 / math.sqrt(ny), 1.0 / math.sqrt(ny))

    def forward(self, f):
        mx = torch.einsum('bcyx,cxw->bcyw', f, self.wx) + self.bx
        my = torch.einsum('bcyx,cyv->bcvx', f, self.wy) + self.by
        return mx, my


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        C = spec.in_channels
        self.Z = spec.Z
        self.sh = spec.X // 2
        nroll = 3 * spec.Z + 1
        self.inmix = AxialMix(C, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(3 * C + nroll, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.mix2 = AxialMix(WIDTH, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.fuse = nn.Conv2d(3 * WIDTH, WIDTH, 1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        Z = self.Z
        tsel = torch.cat([obs[:, Z:4 * Z], obs[:, 4 * Z + 1:4 * Z + 2]], dim=1)
        rolled = xroll(tsel, self.sh)
        mx, my = self.inmix(obs)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, rolled, mx, my], dim=1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        ax, ay = self.mix2(x)
        x = F.relu(x + self.fuse(torch.cat([x, ax, ay], dim=1)))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

    def __init__(self, c, ny, nx):
        super().__init__()

HID = 32


def xroll(t, s):
    return torch.cat([t[..., s:], t[..., :s]], dim=-1)


class AxialMix(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, ny, nx):
        super().__init__()
        self.wx = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(c, nx, nx))
        self.wy = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(c, ny, ny))
        self.bx = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(c, 1, nx))
        self.by = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(c, ny, 1))
        nn.init.uniform_(self.wx, -1.0 / math.sqrt(nx), 1.0 / math.sqrt(nx))
        nn.init.uniform_(self.wy, -1.0 / math.sqrt(ny), 1.0 / math.sqrt(ny))

    def forward(self, f):
        mx = torch.einsum('bcyx,cxw->bcyw', f, self.wx) + self.bx
        my = torch.einsum('bcyx,cyv->bcvx', f, self.wy) + self.by
        return mx, my


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        for o in self.outs:
            nn.init.zeros_(o.weight)
            nn.init.zeros_(o.bias)

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        C = spec.in_channels
        self.Z = spec.Z
        self.sh = spec.X // 2
        nroll = 3 * spec.Z + 1
        self.inmix = AxialMix(C, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(3 * C + nroll, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.mix2 = AxialMix(WIDTH, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.fuse = nn.Conv2d(3 * WIDTH, WIDTH, 1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.bias)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        Z = self.Z
        tsel = torch.cat([obs[:, Z:4 * Z], obs[:, 4 * Z + 1:4 * Z + 2]], dim=1)
        rolled = xroll(tsel, self.sh)
        mx, my = self.inmix(obs)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, rolled, mx, my], dim=1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        ax, ay = self.mix2(x)
        x = F.relu(x + self.fuse(torch.cat([x, ax, ay], dim=1)))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: No trials have run yet. The starting network learned to pick DONE at once on every episode. Its traces show why: the target heights the agent observed are the true design shifted cyclically by X/2 columns. For example, design row 1 '00220000' was observed as '00000022', and this holds on every row of both designs. So the world misaligns the target channels, and the 'missing' and 'extra' channels may be affected too. A stack of two 3x3 convolutions can't see 4 columns away, so it can't line up the target with the build. Random placements earn negative reward, which teaches the agent that DONE (reward 0) is the best move. I don't know if the build channels are also shifted, or if the y axis is affected on other grid sizes. Each candidate therefore gives the network a learned way to mix information across the whole grid, rather than hard-coding the shift: learned per-channel mixing along each axis, or attention over cells with positional encodings. A third candidate also tests a recipe that runs more PPO updates.
analyses.2: The diagnostic traces show the observed target is the real design shifted cyclically by X/2 along x only. Rows match, and design column c appears at column c+X/2. A purely local CNN (the starting net) cannot line up the target with the build, and it collapses to choosing DONE before any placement. Learned axial mixing (r1c1) was the only trial to escape: 0.047 on one seed and 0.004 on the other. On seed 0 it nearly collapsed mid-run (mean episode length 1.6 at 50%) and then recovered. Its twin with a different recipe (r1c3) collapsed completely, so collapse to DONE is a seed-luck problem layered on the alignment problem. When r1c1 does place bricks, it places them almost entirely inside the target (16 cells inside vs 0.2 outside per episode) and then stops too early. Next steps: give the network the alignment directly by concatenating an input copy rolled by X/2 (allowed as slice plus concatenate), and reduce the pull toward DONE.
analyses.3: The observed target, height and missing/extra channels are shifted cyclically by X/2 along x; the traces confirm this. Everything that works undoes the shift. Axial mixing alone scored 0.025 and was unstable. Adding the rolled target copy (r2c1) raised it to 0.48, and the two seeds agree (0.49 and 0.47), so the gain is far larger than seed noise. r2c3 (roll, no axial mixing, more FLOPs and fewer samples) scored 0.13, so the axial mixing and/or the sample count matter. A gentler recipe (r2c2: lower lr, more entropy) hurt badly (0.11), which says learning speed is the bottleneck. r2c1's training success was still climbing steeply at the end (0.20 at 75%, 0.35 at 100%), so it is short of samples. Its greedy failures stop early (DONE) on taller columns of 2–3 layers and leave missing cells. That points to weak credit for the exact-build bonus and to under-training. This round keeps r2c1's network and tests two things: more samples per FLOP (fewer PPO epochs) and longer-horizon credit (higher gamma and lambda).
analyses.4: The observed target is shifted cyclically by X/2 along x, so it does not line up with the build. Adding a copy of the target rolled back by X/2 (r2c1, 0.48) was the breakthrough. Without it, runs collapse to DONE. The rest of the gain came from more samples per FLOP. With 2 PPO epochs, r3c1 reached 0.76 (0.82 and 0.69). With 1 epoch and 64-sample minibatches, r3c3 averaged 0.50, but its seeds diverged: 0.91 and 0.08. One epoch can reach a higher score but is unstable. Its seed-0 training success reached 0.89 and was still rising. Lower lr with more entropy (r2c2) slowed learning. Higher gamma (r3c2) hurt and made the agent stop early. In this last round I try to make the high-sample regime stable. Two levers: larger minibatches (less gradient noise) and a zero-initialised policy output (uniform start, less early drift toward DONE). One candidate isolates zero-init on the 2-epoch best.
